country.evidence_quote: For students who live outside of Ireland the school requires a local guardian be nominated on enrolment. This guardian is a contact on the ground for both student and parent. They take a special interest in their student and support them in their academic progress, language development and overall wellbeing. The Guardian acts as a representative for the parent where required e.g. Parent Teacher Meetings, hospital visits.

contacts.rung: Principal / director (no Erasmus contact found). Niamh McShane is the Principal of the school and the primary contact for institutional inquiries.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Weekend Activities: A wide ranging weekend activity schedule is run throughout the year, with trips to other boarding schools, Ballyhass, Inchydoney Surf School, Killarney, Cliffs of Moher, Cork city, Bowling, Go Karting but to name a few. These activities provide many purposes but mainly an opportunity to bond with fellow students while also seeing what west Cork and Munster have to offer.
